name: DHL Supply Chain - IDS Fulfillment DC - Indianapolis IN

fieldNotes.location: Roster had no address/coords. Resolved via web research: IDS Fulfillment's Indianapolis DC (distinct from the Plainfield IN HQ at idx 2) is at 5425 Exploration Drive, Indianapolis IN 46241 - 'World Connect @ Ameriplex - Building 3', a ~620,935-661,324 sq ft LEED-certified distribution building on ~47 acres, built 2018, in the Ameriplex business park across I-70 from Indianapolis International Airport. IDS opened it in 2018 as its second fulfillment center; now part of DHL Supply Chain after the May 2025 acquisition.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The property is fully perimeter-fenced (chain-link). The truck court is accessed by a driveway from Exploration Drive that enters through a gate in the fence line - confirmed in Street View (2019 + 2024 panos showing fence with a gate opening at the truck driveway). Controlled truck entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the truck gate - Street View shows the gated fence opening with no staffed structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: true - there is a truck gate but no guard shack, implying kiosk/app/call-box check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large ~620k sq ft building with loading docks along the full west face; estimated ~100-120 doors. Banded 50+. Exact count uncertain at available resolution.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive marked, numbered trailer-parking stalls along the west truck court (stalls numbered 70x seen at z20) - a dedicated drop yard. 50+ band.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Imagery captured at a low-occupancy moment - only ~14 trailers visible; the yard capacity is much larger (~90 marked stalls).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide west truck court inside the fence provides interior holding/queue space ahead of the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long curving entry drive from Exploration Drive into the deep truck court - holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck court and broad entry driveway provide ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Southwest Indianapolis, dense airport-adjacent logistics submarket (Ameriplex business park) within the Indy metro - Urban.
